statement: BTOS AI-use share in 2027Q4 is < 1.5x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census BTOS; 2027Q4)
status_at_phase_end: 2025 is the baseline year; shares the BTOS series with I-R2-02 (adoption family, count once). Original wording ('in producing goods or services'): 6.3% (Jan) -> 10.0% (Oct 2025); Jan-Oct mean ~8.4%, so the 1.5x threshold on that basis is ~12.6%. The question was broadened from the 2025-11-17 collection; the first new-wording value (Dec 2025, 17.3%) already exceeds 12.6%, so the indicator cannot be resolved across the break without a splice decision (pending, shared with I-R2-02; owner decision P6b excludes readings from the 2026-10-19 collection on). In-phase growth was +59% Jan-Oct on the old wording, with a mid-year flattening (9.2-9.4% Jun-Sep).

items.summary: Early-2025 reading of the statistics office's biweekly firm survey: 6.3% of firms used AI in producing goods or services (January 2025 average), up from 4.8% a year earlier.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS Jan 2025 monthly average, as tabulated in 'BTOS AI Core Question Updates' (2025-12-03). Release date approximate. Same cluster as BF-2025-I-R2-02-001.

items.summary: Adoption flattened mid-year: 9.2% (June), 9.3% (July), 9.4% (August), 9.3% (September). A plateau of this kind, if repeated, is the pattern the indicator's YES side describes.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS monthly averages from the Census update table. Release date approximate (September cycles published early October). Same cluster as BF-2025-I-R2-02-002.

items.summary: Last original-wording reading: 10.0% (October 2025), +59% since January; expected use in six months 14.1%.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS Oct 2025 monthly average. Release date approximate (federal shutdown Oct-Nov 2025). Same cluster as BF-2025-I-R2-02-003.

items.summary: The statistics office broadened the AI-use question ('in any of its business functions') from the 2025-11-17 collection and started a new series; the original question is no longer asked, so the 2025 baseline exists only on the old wording (Jan-Oct).
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau 'BTOS AI Core Question Updates' (2025-12-03, verified in earlier run). Same cluster as BF-2025-I-R2-02-004.

items.summary: First new-wording reading: 17.3% (December 2025), ~1.7x the last old-wording value - already above the ~12.6% threshold implied by the old-wording 2025 average, which shows the threshold cannot be applied across the break unspliced.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS new series first released 2025-12-04. Same cluster as BF-2025-I-R2-02-005.

items.summary: Derived baseline: mean of Jan-Oct 2025 monthly averages ~8.4% (old wording), so 1.5x ~12.6%. Not a published statistic.
No comparable high-frequency firm AI-use series exists for Bloc B; indicator is single-jurisdiction.
items.detail: No Bloc B NBS biweekly/quarterly firm AI-adoption series found. Same cluster as BF-2025-I-R2-02-007.
